title: Animated Slider
subtitle: Drag a thumb to pick a value or a range.

descriptions.smooth: The thumb moves in fine steps while dragging instead of jumping from step to step.
descriptions.duration: How long the fill takes to catch up when you click the track, in seconds.
descriptions.bounce: Springiness of the fill catching up. 0 means no overshoot.
descriptions.elastic: The track stretches when you drag past either end, then springs back.
descriptions.stretchAmount: How far the track stretches past its ends, in percent of the track width. Needs Elastic on.
descriptions.labels: Shows the current value and the maximum on the rail.
descriptions.thickenedSize: Track thickness while thickened, in Tailwind spacing units. Not used when Thicken on is Never.
descriptions.rounded: Corner radius of the track and fill.
descriptions.marks: Marks drawn at each step along the track.
descriptions.showEdge: Shows a handle at the end of the fill.
descriptions.edgePress: What the handle does while you drag it. Needs Show edge on.
descriptions.edgeVariant: Shape of the handle. Needs Show edge on.
descriptions.bubble: When a bubble with the current value shows above the handle.
descriptions.rollingNumbers: Numbers in the bubble, on the rail and in the readouts roll to the new value.
descriptions.edgeSize: Size of the handle. Needs Show edge on.

patches: "flex min-h-[50vh] flex-col justify-center gap-[4vw] rounded-lg border px-[4vw] py-8 max-md:gap-[10vw]"
"flex min-h-96 max-md:min-h-72 flex-col justify-center gap-12 px-12 py-8 max-lg:px-8 max-md:gap-10 max-md:px-3"

themeDescription: Colour palette. The fill, the handle and the value bubble take its primary colour.
